notes.title: "NeverAwake FLASHBACK," a post-story sequel, is coming in 2025!
notes.notes: [p]It's been a very long time![/p][p]Everyone, are you enjoying your lovely nightmares today as well?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41071912/602683c3792094040c57174e20037430c33e494a.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]New info on "NeverAwake FLASHBACK"![/b][/h2][p]Originally, it started as a DLC featuring a new mode designed for short, arcade-style shooting challenges. However, as development progressed, the team’s ideas and ambitions grew, and the content expanded into a standalone game that offers a fully enjoyable experience on its own.[/p][p]Additionally, with the desire to let more players easily experience the unique system of [i]NeverAwake[/i], we’ve decided to release it as a separate title in 2025.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Please add it to your wishlist![/b][/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3072510/NeverAwake_FLASHBACK/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="7FN94UX-yuw;full"][/previewyoutube][p]The core features we previously announced remain the same, but the game has evolved into a roguelite shooter, offering a fresh new gameplay experience. What’s more, Rem’s beloved companion, “Gabe-chan,” will join the fight as a loyal partner to protect her![/p][p]In addition to all-new stages and bosses, the long-awaited new accessories will also be making their debut![/p][p]  [/p][h3][b]A brand-new nightmare is reborn in true arcade style.[/b][/h3][p][i]Rem has safely awakened from her nightmare.[/i][/p][p][i]The haze in her heart had lifted, and she spent her days in peace and calm.[/i][/p][p][i]But before she knew it, the nightmares returned—haunting her every night once again...[/i][/p][p][i]What could be the cause of these recurring nightmares?[/i][/p][p][i]And will Rem be able to wake up from this new nightmare as well?[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41071912/8a9ef1e3a492b02be071228cc420bd7f2926d66c.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41071912/9379de140fa4a361cdd40fb1da6d0269ac63e2bc.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]For more details...[/p][p]Be sure to check out [i]NeverAwake FLASHBACK[/i]![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3072510/NeverAwake_FLASHBACK/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]And until then—sweet nightmares!![/p]

notes.title: DLC "NeverAwake FLASH BACK" will be released this summer!
notes.notes:
We hope you all have a wonderful nightmare today😈

For those of you who have been enjoying "NeverAwake" a lot, 
we'd like to share with you something that we've been wanting to tell you for a long time!

[b][h2]■The DLC that expands the nightmare world of "NeverAwake" is finally coming this summer![/h2][/b]

NeverAwake FLASH BACK, a new mode that offers a quick arcade shooter-like challenge!
Not only has the game been reborn as a rogue light shooter with a new play feel, but "Gabe-chan", an important character to the Rem, will be joining the game as a sidekick to protect Rem.
In addition, completely new stages and new bosses will be added, as well as long-awaited new accessories!

Further details will be announced at "Shooters Fes 2024," an online event being held from today through tomorrow, where related devs will come together to promote the shooting game community, so please check it out as well.
Please stay tuned for more details on the ever-expanding world of "NeverAwake," which continues to expand even after a year has passed since its release!

New trailer for "NeverAwake FLASH BACK": 
[previewyoutube=OxPAhdzy3dk;full][/previewyoutube]

Shooters Fes 2024 Day1:
[previewyoutube=HdE4Ce1WYmA;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2][b]◇DLC "NeverAwake FLASH BACK"[/b][/h2]

Rem woke up safely from the nightmare.
She was feeling relieved, and was spending her days with a peaceful mind.
But then she realized that she was having nightmares every night again...

What could be the cause of these nightmares?
Will Rem be able to wake up again from more nightmares?

[h3][b]▼The game rules have been redesigned!
Reborn as a rogue light shooting game inspired by the nightmare world of "NeverAwake"!  [/b][/h3]

The basic specifications of "NeverAwake" have been retained, but the style of the game has been changed to a quick arcade shooter style challenge, in which players progress through shuffled stages in a random order, selecting weapons and accessories available between each stage.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41071912/684f1fa45cfdc75819351e7b3c0885aaf1cad17a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41071912/bfce8d0ddaa6f93de25d06df0af8531bc2f5800b.jpg[/img].

[h3][b]▼Many new elements! [/b][/h3]
Gabe-chan joins the game as a sidekick to protect Lem and can now fight together.
Completely new stages & bosses, as well as new accessories!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41071912/e4dba15242cf2da90d93834ab58c097547fbdc03.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41071912/2b20bfca80d093f71728f2df617d2ed6dc517bc5.jpg[/img].

We will keep you posted on the delivery date, price and other details! 

And we wish you have a good nightmares!✨️

notes.title: 【Tips】How to access the ROLLING SWITCH mode
notes.notes:
I hope you all have a wonderful nightmare today!

"Rolling Switch" has been secretly shown at various real events,
In fact, you can play it on your own as long as you have the Steam version and a controller.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41071912/9e6f3970ffb70473deeb2038a78051b1daa77e4d.gif[/img].

The method is simple!
[h3]Just run the Steam version with the following parameters! [/h3]
[h2][b]NeverAwake.exe -enable-rolling-switch[/b][/h2]

Now you have the following specifications.
[list]
[*] so that moving the mouse left or right will cause LEM to roll.
[*] make auto-shot.
[*] decision-button/weapon-firing consolidated into the A button
[/list]

[b]▽Reference[/b]
https://twitter.com/saddy575/status/1727701615636074521


[b]* It is convenient to create a shortcut as shown in the image below. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41071912/388099fad0bbe2c9c1d506f57f56f8f274e46087.jpg[/img]


Inside the arcade controller used in various exhibitions,
It looks like it has a mouse board in addition to the regular arcade controller board, he said.
Preparing the controller is a hurdle, though,
We hope you will find your own way to enjoy "NeverAwake" by using various controllers.

So, continue to have a good nightmare!!!

notes.title: Major Update 1.2.2 is now available!
notes.notes:
I hope you all have a wonderful nightmare today!
Thanks for your patience!

[h1][b]Major Update [Ver. 1.2.2] is available today! [/b][/h1]

The 👀 highlight👀 this time is a collaboration with a great indie game!
Each weapon has a unique performance that is a condensed version of elements from each game, giving new play feel that has never been seen in "NeverAwake" before, so even if you've already enjoyed every aspect of the game, you can enjoy it in a new way ✨.

[h3][b]▼Update Contents[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added 5 new weapons in collaboration with 5 amazing indie games
　　‐「Reflector」 from 『DRAINUS』
　　‐「Head Throw」 from 『ElecHead』
　　‐「Sun Blade」 from 『GRAND CROSS: ReNOVATION』
　　‐「Emerald Vajra」 from 『VRITRA HEXA』
　　‐「UFO Capsule」 from 『Super UFO Fighter』
[*]Added New accessory "Quick Badge" 
[*] Official implementation of speedrun mode
[*] Other minor fixes
[/list]

-------

[h2][b]Update New Trailer✨[/b][/h2]
[previewyoutube=eR-SS0micXo;full][/previewyoutube]

-------

[h2][b]▼Here are some amazing indie games we recommend to all "NeverAwake" players ▼[/b][/h2]

[h3][u]◯"DRAINUS" by Team Ladybug[/u][/h3]
The 2D side-scrolling shooter "DRAINUS", which aims to be "anyone can clear the game", features the "Reflector", which absorbs enemy bullets, as its most distinctive feature! Attack with the absorbed energy!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1975360/DRAINUS/	 

[h3][u]◯"ElecHead" by NamaTakahashi[/u][/h3]
From the fluttering 2D action puzzler "ElecHead," Rem has mastered the "Head Throw" a technique to throw his head like the main character's robot "Elec! Use the electricity that travels between your body and your head to round up all of your enemies!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1456880/ElecHead/
 
[h3][u]◯"GRAND CROSS: ReNOVATION" by ES4[/u][/h3]
From the super-attack vertical scrolling shooter "GRAND CROSS: ReNOVATION" comes the strongest weapon in STG history, the "Sun Blade"! Cleave all your enemies with its overwhelming power!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1808900/GRAND_CROSS_ReNOVATION/

[h3][u]◯"VRITRA HEXA" by Neotro[/u][/h3]
From the "NeverAwake" developer's previous 2D fantasy arcade shooter "VRITRA HEXA" comes the treasure trove "Emerald Vajra"! With bullets that track opponents and a fixed turret, this is a great choice for beginners!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/892830/VRITRA_COMPLETE_EDITION/

[h3][u]◯"SUPER UFO FIGHTER" by VV LABO[/u][/h3]
From the 1vs1 crane game battle "SUPER UFO FIGHTER" comes "UFO Capsule"! The capsule, which suddenly appears in the nightmare world, kills two birds with one stone by being used for both shielding and scoring!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1277870/

-------

[h2][b]And finally, the Xbox Series X|S version is now available! [/b][/h2]
The above mentioned updates are of course available for the Xbox Series X|S version, which is available today,
Switch/ PS4/ PS5 and all other consumer versions of the game!


So, everyone, continue to have a good nightmare! 😈

notes.title: SpeedRun mode Available NOW!
notes.notes:
We hope you all have a wonderful nightmare today.

Thank you for your interest in the SpeedRun mode that we introduced in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1727180/view/3672157322338030628?l=english]this article[/url] recently.
Thanks to the many people who have played the mode and provided us with various suggestions for improvement.

Based on the feedback we received, we have made the following improvements
[h2][b]"SpeedRun mode (beta 2)" has been released! [/b][/h2]

[h3][b]■Improvements[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted to display elapsed time (stops during demo and loading)
[*] Adjusted to display regulations.
[*] Adjusted text to be larger during demo scenes.
[*] Fixed highscore registration dialog not to appear.
[/list]

We'd really appreciate it if you'd give <Beta 2> a try and post your feedback in this thread!
Also, for those of you who haven't played it yet, here it is again.

[h3][b]■How to set the SpeedRun mode[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Go to the the NeverAwake gamepage in the Steam client (library).
[*] Select "Properties" from the gear icon on the right side of the screen.
[*] Type "-enable-speedrun" in the launch options on the General screen.
[*] Launch the game of NeverAwake.
[*] If you see "SPEED RUN MODE" under "GAME START", success!
[/list]

[h3][b]■SpeedRun Mode Specifications [/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Initially equipped with "Candy".
[*] Almost all accessories are available for purchase from the start.
[*] Tutorial and some demos cut.
[*] Save data is not saved and does not affect existing data in progress.
[/list]

Our team will continue to work hard to make the game even better.
Thank you very much for your continued support!

We wish you have a good nightmares!

notes.title: NeverAwake - FAQ
notes.notes:
Here's FAQs!

[list]
[*] [u][h3]Do you support keyboard & mouse? [/h3][/u]
　Yes, we do!

[*] [u][h3]Is there support for consumer devices? [/h3][/u]
　PS4/PS5/Switch: Now available! 
                              For more information, please visit the [url=https://neverawake.neotro.jp/]official website[/url].
　Xbox: Currently under consideration. We will let you know when we have updated information.

[*] [u][h3]Any plans for Mac/Linux support? [/h3][/u]
　Mac: Currently under consideration. We will let you know when we have updated information.
　Linux: Undecided.

[*] [u][h3]Is Steam Deck supported? [/h3][/u]
　Supported in Ver 1.1.0 !

　Guidelines are [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1727180/view/3283711072063003948]HERE[/url].

　Scores are divided based on which Regulation loadout used on each stage.

　Please check and write to us at this [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1727180/discussions/0/3369279464988983842/]bug report board[/url].
